pages.phone: RecordLayout stacks: Artikel, delivery card, then Käufer:in / Bezahlung / Rechnung.

'Bestellung stornieren' is an outline header button instead of a red ⋯ item; it is hidden for shop.manage users without payments.refund even for unpaid orders.

'Wieder öffnen' and 'Erledigt' change status without confirm; reopening a completed order has no undo hint.
Facts are hand-made text blocks in FormCards, not <DetailList> as docs/design/app.md requires.
The tracking form doubles as the 'mark shipped' action: the same button reads 'Als versendet markieren' or 'Speichern' depending on status.

'Vorschlag' (suggested price) is always visible even when 'Preis selbst wählen' is off.
The Lager (stock bookings) is a separate page; the variant table's 'Stückzahl' edits the same stock directly (booked as correction), so there are two ways to change stock.
